workflows.name: Demand intake & routing
workflows.description: Capture, classify, assess evidence and select a demand route.

workflows.name: Bug fix
workflows.description: Reproduce, diagnose, plan a regression and implement a scoped fix.

workflows.name: Feature delivery
workflows.description: Clarify scope, agree acceptance, approve a plan and build the feature.

workflows.name: Maintenance & dependencies
workflows.description: Inspect compatibility and consumers before applying a bounded update.

workflows.name: Security remediation
workflows.description: Assess exposure, obtain owner and specialist decisions, then prepare a controlled remedy.

workflows.name: Incident response
workflows.description: Diagnose, propose containment, obtain operational authority and prepare a minimal hotfix.

workflows.name: Discovery / investigation
workflows.description: Read-only investigation ends in a human go, clarify or stop decision.

workflows.name: Verification
workflows.description: Run configured checks and persist evidence for the exact revision.

workflows.name: Actual-diff reassessment
workflows.description: Reassess impact and invalidate stale or expanded-scope approvals.

workflows.name: PR preparation & draft publication
workflows.description: Describe the verified change and optionally publish a draft PR under explicit write policy.

workflows.name: PR review lifecycle
workflows.description: Inspect readiness, claim a new revision, review, save, optionally comment and observe.

workflows.name: Final approvals & merge readiness
workflows.description: Obtain revision-bound acceptance and hand off to governed GitHub merge; no merge action.

workflows.name: Bounded rework & escalation
workflows.description: Repair failed verification or review within scope; escalate after two attempts.
